Lumen hypervisor theme customizer

Lumen theme for the Proxmox VE web interface. Pick a preset or set your own colours, fonts and shapes, check them on the mock-up and download the theme files with the installer. Everything happens in this page; nothing is uploaded. Token files are the same as for the other Lumen themes.

Start

Colours (dark mode)

Switch the mode above the preview to edit the other palette.

    Typography

    Sora ships with the theme. Other fonts must be installed on the computers that open the interface.

    Shape and layout

    Files

    The ZIP holds the dark, light and follow-system theme files, the Sora font, a theme picker page, the installer and your token file. On the node: unzip, then ./install.sh (dry run) and ./install.sh --yes.

    A mock-up with invented data, built from the interface's own element classes, so the real theme file styles it. It is not the real interface.

    A Luminare Development open-source project, MIT licence. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Proxmox Server Solutions GmbH; Proxmox VE is named only to describe what the theme works with.

    Import tokens

    Paste a Lumen token JSON (an export from any Lumen theme works) or pick a file.
